update_description: Added a bar that users can input a custom threshold for gene expression levels into. Doesnt require clicking search or a table refresh, just type in the number and itll change.
Slight change to RA dot and line plots, as they would flash as if reloading despite reload button not be pressed.
Just a lot of bug fixes, and mainly, moving the download buttons to the lefthand side of the pages, rather then on the figure container on the right.

Relatively small resolution update, focusing on forcing container widths to remain consistent, among other things. Not much technical change, just a lot of CSS edits to fix up resolution and screen size related stuff.
Also, weve got cell numbers and statistics working! Forgot that existed for a few monthes, actually.
CURRENTLY KNOWN BUGS: - legend for gene coexpression is a thin sliver, due to css funkiness, i believe.

This release focused on network and startup performance. The home page now avoids eagerly bootstrapping the staged and subset tabs, preview imagery was reduced to web-sized assets, and the initial #home startup payload is smaller than in earlier versions. The same release also included follow-up layout and responsiveness fixes across the interactive pages, plus cleanup for the spermatogonia modal and staged/subset statistics panels.
